jobs.title: Analog IC Design Engineer | LP SP
jobs.description:
Join the forefront of space technology!
Space Power is pioneering radiation-hardened devices to power the next generation of satellite systems and space-based data centers.
We are seeking an experienced Analog Design Engineer to join our design team to develop the next generation of radiation-hardened devices. You will play a critical role in developing and implementing robust architectures resilient to the challenges of the space radiation environment. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of designing power delivery solutions to the space data center market.
Why Space Power?
Space Power is a rapidly growing, high-margin business within TI, dedicated to developing industry-leading ICs that reliably power satellites in the harsh radiation environment of space. As a key member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to innovate and lead in a market with significant growth potential. Our diverse product portfolio includes point-of-load switching converters, linear regulators, PWM and multi-phase controllers, GaN power stages, supervisors & sequencers, and charge pumps - all enabling the future of technological advances in space.
Minimum requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
- 5 years of relevant analog integrated circuit design experience
Preferred qualifications:
- Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes
- Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
- Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
- Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Why TI?
- The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
- Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .
- At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .
About Texas Instruments
Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, disability, genetic information, national origin, gender, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
